**Given:**

7.44... + 3.77... - 2.55... 

**Concept used:**

The numbers of the form (p/q), where q ≠ 0 and p and q is integer is known as rational number.

**Calculation:**

By applying BODMAS rule on given number,

7.44... + **3.77... - 2.55... **

=> 7.44 + 1.22</st
